figurative_meaning_en: To conduct a meticulous or thorough search
similar_in_english: Go through with a fine-tooth comb
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চিঠিটি উকুন বাছা করে পড়ল।
পুলিশ ঘটনাস্থল উকুন বাছা করে তদন্ত করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She read the letter by picking lice over it.
The police are investigating the scene meticulously.
history: Originates from the traditional rural practice of carefully picking lice from hair, symbolizing detailed scrutiny in everyday Bengali life.
note: The idiom reflects hygiene and patience in rural Bengali culture.
